scene_outline: Detective Silas Voss searches an abandoned clock tower and discovers an encrypted brass cylinder concealed inside a grandfather clock.
He activates the cylinder's interface, revealing a holographic ledger containing names of corrupt city magistrates.
The tower's surveillance alarm trips, signaling that an enforcer patrol has surrounded the perimeter.
Silas rappels down the exterior clock face into the rainy alleyways below.
He is ambushed by a pair of armed enforcers and forced into a shootout behind a steam-vent barricade.
Silas disables the enforcers and slips into the lower transit tunnels, noticing the cylinder has started a 24-hour self-destruct countdown.
